note: Primitive Routt NF (Yampa RD) campground at Chapman Reservoir off Dunckley Pass on the Flat Tops Trail Scenic Byway, between Yampa and Meeker: 5 mi on County Road 17, then County Road 132/8 for 7 mi, then 1 mi on FR 940. Camp host on site in summer. Don't park in a campsite to reach the lake unless you have paid for it. Dispersed camping along FR 940 on the way in. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed 12 sites, 22-ft maximum trailer length (agency's own figure), vault toilet, no potable water, $20 cash/check, no rec.gov listing (FCFS). Added season note (typically June-October). Note's 'Memorial Day to mid-October' (contradicted), its field restatements and its '23-ft Class C fits marginally' claim removed.
flags: CRITERIA (rig length) - DROP CANDIDATE: the agency itself states the limit. The Forest Service page says 'The campground offers 12 campsites with a 22-foot maximum length for trailers.' (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/chapman-reservoir-campground, description paragraph; page last updated August 28, 2025). The figure is the agency's, not an aggregator's. A posted trailer limit under 23 ft applies to EKKO's 23-ft Class C (standing rule), so this is a drop under the 23-ft rule unless AWH makes an exception.

Waterfront (lakeview) check: the FS page says 'Some of the campsites offer a beautiful view of Chapman Reservoir and the Little Flat Tops.' On imagery the camp loop (at the pin) sits ~150-200 m east of the reservoir's high-water shore, behind a strip of conifers with an open meadow running to the shore south of it. No site has an open apron to the water, so lakeview (not lakefront) is consistent; no change.
No reservation listing: rec.gov 232159 'CHAPMAN CAMPGROUND AND GROUP' is the Chapman campground near Ruedi Reservoir (White River NF), not this one.
Status: none of the Medicine Bow-Routt alerts (Big Creek Lakes Dam, Stillwater Reservoir projects) concern Chapman or FR 940.
Pin 40.18666,-107.08622 equals the FS coordinates and sits on the campground loop. OK.
